title: StreamHear: Domain-Adapted Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Streaming Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.13717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) underperforms on domain-shifted target audio, where labeled in-domain data is costly to prepare while unlabeled audio is abundant. We present StreamHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that adapts a pretrained streaming student by fine-tuning an offline transducer teacher on the labeled training set, generating pseudo-labels on the unlabeled portion, and fine-tuning the student on the mixture. We further introduce a prior-regularized dynamic-programming realignment step that fixes chunk-level word placement using an ASR-hypothesis anchor. Across four datasets spanning financial calls, prepared read speech, and phone-quality dialogue, StreamHear consistently outperforms supervised student fine-tuning and narrows the gap to the offline teacher.

translated_title: StreamHear：面向半监督流式语音识别的域自适应伪标签方法
translated_abstract: 流式自动语音识别（ASR）在域偏移的目标音频上表现不佳，其中标注的域内数据准备成本高昂，而未标注的音频却大量存在。我们提出了StreamHear，一种半监督流水线，它通过在标注训练集上微调离线转导器教师模型，在未标注部分生成伪标签，并在混合数据上微调流式学生模型，从而适配预训练的流式学生模型。我们进一步引入了一种先验正则化的动态规划重对齐步骤，该步骤使用ASR假设锚点来修正块级词位置。在涵盖金融电话、准备朗读语音和电话质量对话的四个数据集上，StreamHear始终优于有监督的学生微调方法，并缩小了与离线教师模型的差距。
tldr: StreamHear通过半监督伪标签和先验正则化重对齐，显著提升了流式ASR在域偏移场景下的性能，并缩小了与离线模型的差距。
en_tdlr: StreamHear enhances streaming ASR performance under domain shift via semi-supervised pseudo-labeling and prior-regularized realignment, narrowing the gap to offline models.
